Click this button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp207-img1.png) to open Frequency plans tool.
The tool enables you to create frequency plans that will be necessary to create a link and later be used in calculations.
![Image p207](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp207-img2.png)
Move the mouse cursor over the frequency plan and delete it using Delete button.
![Image p207](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp207-img3.png)
3.1.36.1 Import frequency plan
To import a frequency plan press the New frequency plan button
![Image p207](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp207-img4.png)
and then select Import channels CVS.
![Image p208](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp208-img1.png)
![Image p208](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp208-img2.png)
To start the import procedure, select or drag and drop the frequency channel csv file. Here is an example:
![Image p208](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp208-img3.png)
3.1.36.2 Add frequency plan manually
To add manually a frequency plan press the New frequency plan button
![Image p209](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp209-img1.png)
and then select Create manually.
![Image p209](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp209-img2.png)
![Image p209](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp209-img3.png)
**General**
**Name**
Frequency Plan identification
**Duplex**
Specifies whether the signal can be transmitted and received simultaneously. Changing the duplex mode will affect the carrier selection.
**Generate channels**
**Low/high frequency**
Frequencies in MHz.
**Carrier spacing**
The frequency separation between adjacent carrier frequencies in a communication system, ensuring non- interference between carriers.
**Duplex spacing**
Frequency separation between the transmit and receive bands in a two-way communication system.
**Index of first channel**
The numbering start point for generated channels.
**Generate channels**
Creates a list of channels based on the inputs.
**Channels**
**Add channel**
Allows manual addition of individual channels to the frequency plan.
![Image p210](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp210-img1.png)
**Channel**
Channel identifier.
**Frequency**
Channel's frequency value in MHz.
Add channel using *Add channel below* button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp210-img2.png)
Delete channel using *Delete channel* button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp211-img3.png)
